meta.name: Rural Tourism Mentor knowledge bank
meta.status: AI-researched. No row has been reviewed by a human expert. Regulatory rows must be checked against original official texts before reliance. Source pages were read through a summarising fetch tool; original gazette/PDF text was not fully reviewed for most sources.
meta.how_to_use: One source among several. Retrieve the 3-5 closest rows, prefer them, add your own knowledge, label answers grounded in rows with their sources. If volatile_figures is true, give the figure only with its as-of date and say to confirm it; never present state-specific rules as national; for confidence 'low' give the method and the referral, not a specific rule. Do not repeat verification wording from the row verbatim to hosts.

sources.title: FAQs on Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses (26 Jul 2022)
sources.covers: Who needs registration or licence (caterers, temples/prasad, cloud kitchens, e-commerce, milk sellers), SHG home-worker exemption (Q12), annual return Form D1, FoSCoS login and documents list pointer.

sources.title: Press Release: MoHFW approves major regulatory reforms (13 Mar 2026)
sources.issuer: FSSAI / Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
sources.covers: 2026 reforms: perpetual validity of registration and licence, registration limit raised from Rs 12 lakh to Rs 1.5 crore, State licence up to Rs 50 crore, deemed registration of street vendors, risk-based inspection.
sources.status_note: Reforms effective 1 Apr 2026.
sources.reading_depth: summary via fetch tool; original text not fully reviewed

sources.title: FSSAI FAQs on Licensing and Registration Amendment Regulations, 2026 (27 Mar 2026)
sources.covers: Gazette notification of 10 Mar 2026; new turnover bands effective 1 Apr 2026; perpetual validity; no migration fee; licence number unchanged; automatic migration on self-declaration; high-risk food keeps full hygiene rules.
sources.status_note: Supersedes the Rs 12 lakh registration limit quoted in older FSSAI documents. Document was opened through a text-summarising fetch tool.
sources.reading_depth: summary via fetch tool; original text not fully reviewed
